subject: Error when trying to deploy to shinyapps.io: application depends on package "BH"

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Error when trying to deploy to shinyapps.io: application depends on package "BH"
parts:
When I try to deploy my application using `deployApp()`, I get the following error message:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...
Error: 
* Application depends on package "BH" but it is not installed. Please resolve before continuing.


However, my application does no depend on BH, I didn't even know what that package was. I typed "library(BH)" and I got a message saying that there is no package called BH.
Yet I can run the shiny app within RStudio, but deploying keeps giving me this error.

Does anyone know how to fix this or what the cause is?

Thanks!

messages.author: bf33dde199257034
messages.subject: Re: Error when trying to deploy to shinyapps.io: application depends on package "BH"
parts:
You need to install the package before calling it.
so,
install.packages("BH")
then include 
library(BH)
in your ui.R file

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Error when trying to deploy to shinyapps.io: application depends on package "BH"
parts:
One possible reason is that you have an R script (not necessarily ui.R
or server.R) in your app, in which you loaded one of the packages that
depend on BH (e.g. library(dplyr)), but you did not really use that R
script in the app. In that case, the shinyapps package will analyze
all your R scripts in the app and still pick up BH as the dependency
of your app, although it really is not.

It is easier to diagnose the issue if you can provide the full source
code of your app.

Regards,
Yihui
